news.title: Nano Nuclear Signs MOU with UrAmerica
news.text: Nano Nuclear entered a memorandum of understanding with UrAmerica to modernize Argentina's nuclear fuel supply chain.

news.title: H.C. Wainwright Reiterates Buy Rating
news.text: H.C. Wainwright maintained a Buy rating and $12 price target, citing confidence in Betalutin's potential within NHL therapy.

news.title: Prototype Annular Linear Induction Pump Completed
news.text: Nano Nuclear finished assembling a prototype Annular Linear Induction Pump for upcoming testing.

news.title: Nano Nuclear Joins Canadian Nuclear Association
news.text: The company joined the Canadian Nuclear Association to advocate for next-generation nuclear energy adoption.

news.title: Facility Acquired in Oak Brook, Illinois
news.text: Nano Nuclear purchased an Oak Brook facility to accelerate development of its KRONOS MMR microreactor system.

news.title: Included in Solactive Global Uranium Index
news.text: Nano Nuclear was added to the Solactive Global Uranium & Nuclear Components Total Return Index, qualifying it for the Global X Uranium ETF.

news.title: Q3 2025 Results Highlight Cash Position
news.text: The company reported a year-to-date operating loss of $35.8 million but noted a stronger balance sheet after a $99 million private placement.

news.title: MOU Signed with Dioxitek of Argentina
news.text: Nano Nuclear signed a memorandum with Dioxitek S.A. to pursue opportunities in Argentina's nuclear fuel supply chain.

news.title: Letter of Intent with Cambridge Atom Works
news.text: In early September 2025, Nano Nuclear signed a letter of intent with Cambridge Atom Works to commercialize its portable ODIN reactor technology.

news.title: H.C. Wainwright Reaffirms Buy with $50 Target
news.text: Analysts reiterated their Buy rating, underscoring confidence in Nano Nuclear's technology roadmap.

news.title: Added to S&P Global Broad Market Index
news.text: Nano Nuclear achieved inclusion in the S&P Global BMI, broadening institutional ownership potential.

news.title: Oversubscribed $400 Million Private Placement Announced
news.text: In October 2025 the company disclosed a $400 million oversubscribed private placement priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules.

news.title: CEO Presents at Benchmark Tech Conference
news.text: Nano Nuclear's CEO Jay Jiang Yu presented at the Benchmark Company Technology Conference to highlight growth initiatives.

news.title: Benchmark Initiates Coverage with Buy Rating
news.text: Benchmark started coverage on Nano Nuclear with a Buy rating and $40 price target.

news.title: H.C. Wainwright Reiterates Bullish View
news.text: H.C. Wainwright again reiterated a Buy rating following investor outreach in late October.
